17 call sites still pass the legacy second argument (the `src\lib\format.js:6` match is just the function definition, not a call site).

**`src\reports\quarterly.js`** has the most, with 5:
- line 16 (`bundle`), 37 (`holdback`), 58 (`subtotal`), 83 (`surcharge`), 104 (`gross`)

The rest: `admin\exports.js` (3), `billing\invoice.js` (3), `checkout\cart.js` (2), `reports\monthly.js` (2), `billing\statement.js` (1), `checkout\receipt.js` (1).
